blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) and the United States Department of Homeland Security Investigations (HSI) strengthen cooperation to track down traffickers and online child abusers’ operations across borders. The two agencies discussed their partnership in investigating crimes during HSI attaché Stephen James Richardson’s courtesy visit to Camp Crame on Tuesday. In a statement on Wednesday, PNP chief Gen. Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr. said some cases require authorities in different jurisdictions to exchange information and coordinate investigative and law enforcement efforts.
